title: Trigger-Based Linearization
text: Generate linear models in base workspace when triggered, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time (of linearized model)} sets Sample time; {Trigger type} sets the signal type that triggers generation of a linear model. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Trigger type
params.values: Signal type that triggers generation of a linear model rising | falling | either | function-call
